datumHeadline: The model shows one opening it cannot vouch for
datumNumbers: {{id}} — clears the buttress edge by {{clear}} mm, on a tracing that scatters ±{{tol}} mm
datumBody: The buttress edge is hand-traced from satellite imagery [OSM], and that tracing's own nodes agree only to ±{{tol}} mm on the face of the drum. This opening clears the edge by {{clear}} mm — less than the scatter — so whether it exists is decided by the tracing rather than by the tower. It is cut, and said out loud, rather than asserted. A survey of the buttress, or the İçərişəhər drawings, would settle it.
